title: Grzesik–Lee–Lidický–Volec conjecture on apices of Sidorenko graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a connected graph with the Sidorenko property. For an integer $k$, the **$k$-apex** of $G$ is obtained by adding $k$ independent vertices, each adjacent to every vertex of $G$. **Grzesik–Lee–Lidický–Volec conjecture.** The $k$-apex of $G$ is common for every $k$. This conjecture concerns the classification of common graphs, where a graph is common when its Ramsey multiplicity equals the random-coloring benchmark. The paper proves the assertion for $k\leq 5$ when $G$ is a tree, while the general conjecture remains open.
source_name: Daniel Kráľ, Matjaž Krnc and Ander Lamaison, “Ramsey multiplicity of apices of trees”, arXiv:2403.15808 (2025).
